note: Golden cases for split-plan@1 (framework/spec/BUILD-SPLIT.md). `in` is hand-written; `out` is generated by: node framework/spec/check-build-split.mjs --write. Every port replays `in` and must answer `out`. ids: split id, part ref, branch and session formats. plans: planParts(build, freeSlots, fileClaims) at 2026-11-18T12:00:00.000Z. validate: mutations of the three-part plan of `build` and the errors each must raise.

plans.name: three file groups, three slots: three parts, every slot filled
three file groups, six slots: only three parts (nothing is split past its file groups)
three file groups, two slots: heaviest group first onto the lightest part, steps in build order
one slot: one part with every open step in build order; done and skipped steps left out
the planner's file claims merge with step files: a claim joins two groups
every step touches one shared file: one part however many slots are free
no claims anywhere: one part (nothing is assumed independent without evidence)
a second run of a build counts up its split id
no free slot: nothing planned, the run waits
every step done: nothing to plan

machine.note: Scripts on the three-part plan of validate.build (base aaaa…, maxRebuilds 2 unless set). ops: part <event> (partNext), failed (onPartFailed), run <to> (runNext), rollup (applyRollUp). Times step by one minute from 2026-11-18T12:01.

scripts.name: happy path: every part launched, ticked and green; combine, CI, merge, live, finished
a part fails once: rebuilt from the same base while the others keep going
a part fails for good: the run fails, the waiting part is abandoned, nothing moves after
a crash before the first tick: back to waiting, relaunched; the run stays building
refused: green on a waiting part, combining before every part is done, a done part re-launched, a jump past CI
green without a head is refused; all-or-nothing: two of three done is not ready
combine conflict: back to building, the clashing part rebuilt, combined again; red CI goes back to combining, then green
maxRebuilds 0: the first failure fails the run
